title: VeriPIE: Checkable Query Plans and Evidence-Guided Selection for Text-to-SQL
abstract: arXiv:2610.17493v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Financial Artificial Intelligence (AI) governance and model risk management (MRM) emphasize independent validation, transparency, and effective challenge of AI-generated computations. Text-to-SQL translates natural-language questions into Structured Query Language (SQL), but queries that agree on one database can still express different computations. We present VeriPIE, a neurosymbolic framework combining language-model generation with symbolic checks. It ensembles direct SQL generation with QuerySketch, a structured plan language checked by a backend implemented in Lean, a theorem prover and programming language. Plan diagnostics guide repair before SQL generation, while execution agreement and bounded searches for distinguishing databases inform candidate selection. These checks expose malformed plans and hidden disagreement without proving agreement with the user's intent. In single-run experiments on the complete Spider development

translated_title: VeriPIE：面向Text-to-SQL的可检查查询计划与证据引导的选择方法
translated_abstract: 金融人工智能（AI）治理与模型风险管理（MRM）强调对AI生成计算的独立验证、透明性和有效质疑。Text-to-SQL将自然语言问题转换为结构化查询语言（SQL），但在同一数据库上执行结果一致的查询仍可能表达不同的计算。我们提出了VeriPIE，一个将语言模型生成与符号检查相结合的神经符号框架。它将直接SQL生成与QuerySketch（一种结构化计划语言）集成在一起，QuerySketch由一个基于Lean（一种定理证明器与编程语言）实现的后端进行检查。计划诊断信息在SQL生成之前引导修复，而执行一致性结果以及对可区分数据库的有界搜索则为候选查询的选择提供依据。这些检查能够暴露格式错误的计划和隐藏的分歧，但并不能证明查询与用户意图的一致性。在完整的Spider开发集上的单次运行实验
tldr: VeriPIE是一个神经符号框架，通过基于Lean定理证明器的后端对语言模型生成的结构化查询计划进行符号检查，并结合计划诊断修复、执行一致性与区分性数据库搜索等证据来选择候选SQL，从而暴露Text-to-SQL中格式错误的计划和隐藏的语义分歧。
en_tdlr: VeriPIE is a neurosymbolic Text-to-SQL framework that checks language-model-generated structured query plans via a Lean-based backend, using plan diagnostics, execution agreement, and bounded searches for distinguishing databases to expose malformed plans and hidden disagreement and guide candidate selection.
